plans.purpose: To give a manageable overview before choosing where to study more deeply.
plans.bestFor: Seeing the big picture before deeper study
plans.estimatedTime: About 5–10 minutes reading; allow another 5–10 for reflection. Longer chapters may take more time.
plans.coverage: A focused set of 12 readings from Genesis 1 to Revelation 21.
plans.rhythm: Read the passage, use any guidance provided, reflect and pray, then complete the day when you are ready.

plans.title: Old Testament Overview in 60 Days
plans.description: A broad chapter-by-chapter overview of the Old Testament.
plans.purpose: To help readers follow the Old Testament's major movements of creation, covenant, promise, kingdom, exile, wisdom, prophecy, judgment, and hope.
plans.bestFor: Readers who want Old Testament orientation before detailed book study.
plans.estimatedTime: 30-50 minutes
plans.coverage: 60 readings beginning with Genesis 1-16 and ending with Zechariah 4-14; Malachi 1-4.
plans.rhythm: Read for the movement of the book, notice covenant setting and repeated themes, then write one question for later study.
days: Micah 7; Nahum 1-3; Habakkuk 1-3; Zephaniah 1-3; Haggai 1-2; Zechariah 1-3

plans.title: New Testament Overview
plans.description: A broad chapter-by-chapter overview of the New Testament.
plans.purpose: To help readers see the New Testament's flow from Jesus' ministry to the church's witness, apostolic teaching, and final hope.
plans.bestFor: Readers who want a broad New Testament orientation before slower study.
plans.estimatedTime: 20-35 minutes
plans.coverage: 30 readings beginning with Matthew 1-9 and ending with Revelation 15-22.
plans.rhythm: Read for how each section bears witness to Christ, forms His people, and calls for faithful response.

plans.title: Bible Story in 30 Days
plans.description: Follow creation, covenant, Jesus, the church and new creation through selected chapters.
plans.estimatedTime: About 5–10 minutes reading; allow another 5–10 for reflection. Longer chapters may take more time.
plans.coverage: 30 selected chapters, not every chapter of the Bible.
plans.purpose: To give a manageable overview before choosing where to study more deeply.
plans.bestFor: Seeing the big picture before deeper study
plans.rhythm: Read the passage, use any guidance provided, reflect and pray, then complete the day when you are ready.

plans.title: Bible Story in 60 Days
plans.description: A more spacious introduction to Scripture's story through 60 selected chapters.
plans.estimatedTime: About 5–10 minutes reading; allow another 5–10 for reflection. Longer chapters may take more time.
plans.coverage: 60 selected chapters, not every chapter of the Bible.
plans.purpose: To give a manageable overview before choosing where to study more deeply.
plans.bestFor: Seeing the big picture before deeper study
plans.rhythm: Read the passage, use any guidance provided, reflect and pray, then complete the day when you are ready.

plans.title: Old Testament Story in 60 Days
plans.description: Selected chapters introduce the Old Testament's story, worship, wisdom and prophetic hope.
plans.estimatedTime: About 5–10 minutes reading; allow another 5–10 for reflection. Longer chapters may take more time.
plans.coverage: 60 selected chapters, not every chapter of the Bible.
plans.purpose: To give a manageable overview before choosing where to study more deeply.
plans.bestFor: Seeing the big picture before deeper study
plans.rhythm: Read the passage, use any guidance provided, reflect and pray, then complete the day when you are ready.

plans.title: Psalms for Prayer
plans.description: Twenty-one selected Psalms for praise, lament, confession, trust and thanksgiving.
plans.estimatedTime: About 5–10 minutes reading; allow another 5–10 for reflection. Longer chapters may take more time.
plans.coverage: 21 selected chapters, not every chapter of the Bible.
plans.purpose: To help you turn Scripture into prayer, trust, worship, and honest dependence on God.
plans.bestFor: Prayer, devotional reading, and reflection
plans.rhythm: Read the passage, use any guidance provided, reflect and pray, then complete the day when you are ready.

plans.title: New Testament in 1 Year
plans.description: One chapter at a time, with reflection days spread throughout the year.
plans.pace: One chapter or a reflection reading daily
plans.estimatedTime: About 5–10 minutes reading; allow another 5–10 for reflection. Longer chapters may take more time.
plans.coverage: All 260 chapters, with 105 reflection days distributed across the year.
plans.purpose: To help you stay with one Bible book long enough to notice its flow and message.
plans.bestFor: Slow book-by-book reading
plans.rhythm: Read the passage, use any guidance provided, reflect and pray, then complete the day when you are ready.

plans.title: Psalms and Proverbs in 1 Year

plans.estimatedTime: About 5–10 minutes reading; allow another 5–10 for reflection. Longer chapters may take more time.
plans.coverage: All 181 chapters, with 184 reflection days distributed across the year.
plans.purpose: To help you stay with one Bible book long enough to notice its flow and message.

plans.title: Old and New Testament Daily Pairing
plans.description: Read both testaments every day, with occasional New Testament rereadings for reflection.
plans.estimatedTime: About 10–20 minutes reading; allow another 5–10 for reflection. Longer chapters may take more time.
plans.coverage: Every Old and New Testament chapter across 365 days. Some New Testament chapters are revisited to keep both testaments present each day.
plans.purpose: Read both testaments every day, with occasional New Testament rereadings for reflection.
plans.bestFor: Long-term whole Bible reading
plans.rhythm: Read the passage, use any guidance provided, reflect and pray, then complete the day when you are ready.
